name: lime-sync-workspace
description: Compact Rust and SQLite sync server for Zero's real client.

scripts.test: bun run --cwd packages/lime-sync-executor build && bun run --cwd packages/lime-sync-cf-host build:dist && vitest run && bun run test:sync-executor && bun run test:scripts
scripts.test:scripts: bun test scripts/release-publish.test.ts scripts/verify-npm-release.test.ts scripts/release-package-order.test.ts scripts/sync-native-package.test.ts scripts/sync-native-release-plan.test.ts scripts/cache-npm-webauth.test.ts scripts/generate-lime-sync-evidence.test.ts
scripts.check: bun scripts/check-workspace-cycles.ts && bun run --cwd packages/lime-sync-executor typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/lime-sync-executor build && bun run --cwd packages/lime-sync-cf-host typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/lime-sync build:runtime && bun run --cwd packages/lime-sync typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/lime-sync-browser-host typecheck
scripts.check:all: bun run lint && bun run format:check && bun run check && bun run test
scripts.perf:all: bun run perf:bench && bun run perf:overhead && bun run perf:correctness && bun run perf:crash
scripts.perf:ci: bun run perf:bench -- --output=perf/reports/bench.json && bun run perf:overhead && bun run perf:correctness
